summary: Build a slick Python desktop UI app (HemaAssist) to input Full Blood Count (FBC) values and generate automated interpretive comments/reports, including patient details and safety disclaimer.
architectural_notes: UI includes patient details inputs, FBC numeric input grid, a 'Generate' action, and a text output panel.
imageRequirements:
## Required Images
- Minimal hematology-themed app logo mark with a droplet + subtle blood cell motif, clean vector style, dark-on-light (hemaassist-logo.dim_512x512.png)
- Wide header banner illustration with abstract blood cells in a soft neutral palette (no blue/purple dominance), minimal clinical aesthetic (hemaassist-banner.dim_1600x400.png)

existing_features.title: Create a single-page app UI for entering patient details (Patient Name, Patient ID) and Full Blood Count (FBC) values (Hb, RBC, WBC, Platelets, MCV, MCHC, Neutrophils, Lymphocytes, Monocytes, Eosinophils, Basophils).

Implement the FBC auto-comment generation logic in the frontend to match the provided Python rules and thresholds, producing an English text report that includes patient details and the generated interpretive comments.
Add robust input validation and user feedback: ensure all FBC numeric fields are required and numeric; show a clear error message when validation fails and do not generate a report.

Provide a slick output panel that displays the generated report text, and include the medical disclaimer in the UI: "For laboratory assistance only. Final interpretation must be done by a qualified practitioner."

Add primary user actions to improve usability: "Generate FBC Comment" button, plus convenient secondary actions such as "Clear" (reset all inputs/output) and "Copy to Clipboard" for the generated report.
Apply a coherent, modern visual theme (colors, typography, spacing, and component styling) suitable for a clinical/laboratory assistant tool, and enforce it consistently across the app.
Generate and include required static image assets for branding (logo/app mark) and render them in the UI (served from frontend/public/assets/generated), without routing images through the backend.

new_feature_requests.summary: Create a smart/slick desktop UI (Tkinter) for entering FBC results and patient details and generating an auto-comment report output
Implement FBC interpretation logic (flags/thresholds for Hb, MCV, MCHC; WBC total and differential; platelet count) to produce human-readable comments
Add input validation and user feedback (numeric-only field validation with error dialog)
Provide an output panel to display the generated report text and include a medical/lab-assistance disclaimer in the UI
